input.headline: Sales Development Rep | 140% of quota in 2025
input.about: SDR at Lumen Health, selling scheduling software to clinics. In 2025 I hit 140% of quota and booked 212 meetings. I'm in the top 3 of our 18-person SDR team. I've been in sales for 2 years and I'm aiming for an AE role in the next 6 months.

goldFacts: I am an SDR at Lumen Health selling scheduling software to clinics.
I am in the top 3 of an 18-person SDR team.
I have worked in sales for 2 years.
I am aiming for an account executive role within 6 months.

traps.text: Ranked first on the SDR team.
Led SDR onboarding for new hires.

notes: Lots of real numbers. Tests number swaps (212 -> 250) and 'top 3' -> 'first', which FactCheck can't catch (ordinal).
